pages.text: A new OpenComputers computer has no operating system. Craft the $(l)OpenOS floppy$() from a $(item)Floppy Disk$() and the $(item)OpenComputers Manual$(), put it in a disk drive and boot.$(br2)Type $(l)install$() to copy OpenOS to the hard drive.

Handy OpenOS commands:$(li)$(l)man <cmd>$() - manual pages$(li)$(l)components$() - list attached hardware$(li)$(l)edit <file>$() - text editor$(li)$(l)wget <url> <file>$() - download (needs an $(item)Internet Card$())$(li)$(l)pastebin get <id> <file>$()
The official OpenComputers documentation covers every component, API and program.
